legend.A_VERIFIED: rec_id found · guideline + class + level all match
legend.B_METADATA_ERR: rec_id found · class or level reported differently from index
legend.C_GUIDELINE_MISMATCH: rec_id exists in index but under a different guideline
legend.D_NOT_IN_INDEX: rec_id not found anywhere in the recommendation index
legend.E_NO_REC_ID: citation returned with no rec_id field

legend.FALSE_POSITIVE: Claim matches a real indexed rec — judge flagged incorrectly
legend.METADATA_INFLATION: Class/level stated higher or differently than the actual rec
legend.WRONG_APPLICATION: Correct rec misapplied to wrong patient subgroup or scenario
legend.SCOPE_EXPANSION: Broadens a rec's applicability beyond its stated scope
legend.CITATION_MISMATCH: Correct content but wrong citation bracket number in text
legend.VALID_INFERENCE: Clinically valid inference from cited recs, not verbatim
legend.REFUSAL_OVERCLAIM: System refused when passages do address the topic
legend.GENUINE_ERROR: Explicit factual claim with no retrievable rec basis
legend.UNGROUNDED_CORRECT: Clinically accurate, but no retrievable basis in the locked corpus (e.g. guideline table content that was never indexed as a chunk)
legend.WRONG_THRESHOLD: States a numeric decision threshold that does not match the guideline (diameter, stenosis, grade cut-off)
legend.OTHER: Does not fit any of the above patterns
legend.SEVERITY_INFLATION: Overstates urgency or mandate beyond what the cited guidance supports

provenance_gap.definition: Items containing at least one clinically correct claim with no retrievable basis in the locked corpus.
